note: Each entry is a refusal this suite PROVOKED and captured, carrying the exception type and message the guard actually produced. Refusals are demonstrated as artifacts, never asserted in prose.

refusals.expectation: the build fails; no transmitting call site exists here

finding.detail: placeOrder places, modifies or cancels a live order. No such call site exists in this package. Every broker interaction is a whatIf preview or a market-data read.

refusals.scenario: a placeOrder call site appears in the package

refusals.expectation: the build fails on the False literal

finding.detail: whatIf=False. This repository transmits no order, ever.

refusals.scenario: whatIf is written as the literal False

refusals.expectation: the build fails; a non-literal cannot be verified statically

finding.detail: whatIf is supplied from Name, not a literal. A value that is not a literal cannot be verified at build time, so it is refused rather than trusted.

refusals.scenario: whatIf is supplied from a variable rather than a literal

refusals.exception_message: REFUSED: the order object does not carry whatIf=True. The AST scan verifies construction and cannot see a mutation applied afterwards, so the flag is checked again on the object at the moment of use.
refusals.expectation: the run-time check refuses; the AST scan cannot see a later mutation
refusals.scenario: an order object was mutated to whatIf=False after construction

refusals.exception_message: REFUSED and wrote nothing: session declared 'live' and connected to a D-prefixed account, which is 'paper'. Config states an intent, the connection states a fact, and the fact wins.
refusals.expectation: construction raises and the recorder is never handed an object, so nothing is written
refusals.scenario: a session declaring live connected to a D-prefixed account

refusals.exception_message: refusing account prefix 'X': expected D for paper or U for live. An unrecognised prefix means the prefix assumption has broken, and this guard fails rather than defaulting to either side.
refusals.expectation: the guard fails rather than defaulting to either side
refusals.scenario: an account carried neither a D nor a U prefix

refusals.exception_message: REFUSED: the paper-only clause is in force and no live Gateway session runs in this repository. Two operator constraints are recorded rather than worked around: the machine's internal fans are not functioning, so concurrent live and paper sessions are not run, and no separate live profile exists for this project. Lifting the clause is an operator edit to CLAUDE.md, never a flag.
refusals.expectation: refused before a socket is opened; lifting the clause is an operator edit to CLAUDE.md
refusals.scenario: a live session was requested while the paper-only clause is in force

refusals.exception_message: MBT_IB_HOST is unset or empty. Set it in .env, copying the shape from .env.example. This repository holds no default for it, because a default account number or a default port is how a session ends up somewhere nobody chose.
refusals.expectation: the error names the variable, so a reader is not sent to the wrong file
refusals.scenario: a required environment variable was unset

refusals.exception_message: MBT_IB_PAPER_CLIENT_ID is set but is not an integer. The TWS API clientId is an int32, so a non-numeric value cannot be one. Observed shape: length 9, first character class alphabetic. The value itself is not reported: a value of that shape in this slot is most often an account number pasted into it, and an account number never enters a log or an artifact. Set MBT_IB_PAPER_CLIENT_ID to a small integer distinct from every other session against this Gateway.
refusals.expectation: a typed ConfigError naming the variable, never a bare ValueError
refusals.scenario: the client id slot held an account number rather than an integer

refusals.exception_message: REFUSED: figure 'initial_margin_short_mbt_option' of kind 'margin' is tagged environment 'paper' and reached the 'margin' gate. A margin is a property of the account or the fill, both of which paper simulates, so a paper one is development evidence and is never verdict-bearing.
refusals.expectation: raises; a paper margin is development evidence and never verdict-bearing
refusals.scenario: a paper-tagged margin figure was fed to the MARGIN gate

refusals.exception_message: REFUSED: figure 'exchange_and_regulatory_fee' of kind 'commission_report' is tagged environment 'paper' and reached the 'cost' gate. A commission_report is a property of the account or the fill, both of which paper simulates, so a paper one is development evidence and is never verdict-bearing.
refusals.expectation: raises; paper fills are simulated and their reports synthetic
refusals.scenario: a paper-tagged commission report was fed to the COST gate

refusals.exception_message: REFUSED: quote 'straddle_round_trip_bps' carries tick delay status 'delayed' and reached the 'cost' gate. Only a real-time tick is admissible. A delayed quote's spread is stale and artificially wide, and is never widened into a cost band.
refusals.expectation: raises; only a real-time tick is admissible and an unreported status is never assumed live
refusals.scenario: a quote carrying tick delay status 'delayed' reached the COST gate

refusals.expectation: raises; only a real-time tick is admissible and an unreported status is never assumed live
refusals.scenario: a quote carrying tick delay status 'frozen' reached the COST gate

refusals.exception_message: REFUSED: quote 'straddle_round_trip_bps' carries tick delay status 'delayed_frozen' and reached the 'cost' gate. Only a real-time tick is admissible. A delayed quote's spread is stale and artificially wide, and is never widened into a cost band.
refusals.expectation: raises; only a real-time tick is admissible and an unreported status is never assumed live
refusals.scenario: a quote carrying tick delay status 'delayed_frozen' reached the COST gate

refusals.exception_message: REFUSED: quote 'straddle_round_trip_bps' carries tick delay status 'unknown' and reached the 'cost' gate. Only a real-time tick is admissible. A delayed quote's spread is stale and artificially wide, and is never widened into a cost band.
refusals.expectation: raises; only a real-time tick is admissible and an unreported status is never assumed live
refusals.scenario: a quote carrying tick delay status 'unknown' reached the COST gate

refusals.exception_message: the latch for 'margin_short_mbt_option' at /tmp/pytest-of-kiros-li/pytest-19/test_guard_four_a_second_spend0/latches/margin_short_mbt_option.latch.json is already spent. One spend per registered figure. A second deciding read voids the registration; the recorded result stands and is not re-run.
refusals.expectation: the second attempt raises LatchAlreadySpentError; a second deciding read voids the registration
refusals.scenario: the deciding latch for one registered figure was spent twice

refusals.exception_message: no latch for 'cost_absent_legs_p90' at /tmp/pytest-of-kiros-li/pytest-19/test_guard_four_reading_an_unw0/latches/cost_absent_legs_p90.latch.json: a deciding read requires a latch written before it, not after.
refusals.expectation: raises; a latch is written before the read, not after
refusals.scenario: a latched read was attempted with no latch on disk

refusals.exception_message: Absent(no_live_session) refuses float(): a recorded absence is never a value. detail='needs a U-prefixed session'
refusals.expectation: raises; a synthesized zero is indistinguishable from a measured one
refusals.scenario: an absent live-session margin was coerced with float()

refusals.exception_message: cost gate: required a present value, found Absent(insufficient_sample). detail='3 of 20 windows'
refusals.expectation: raises loudly rather than substituting a value
refusals.scenario: an under-sampled census was narrowed with require_present

refusals.exception_message: test: refusing naive datetime datetime.datetime(2026, 9, 3, 12, 0). Every timestamp in this repository is timezone-aware. A naive stamp is never assumed to be UTC and never assumed to be local.
